Examples
Examples for divERGe

Examples are found in the examples/ directory. In the git repository, they are furthermore grouped into programming languages. In the release tarball, all examples are merged within examples/.

For step-by-step tutorials of the python interface, look at examples/*-?-*.py, i.e., either the files

wham-0-init.py
wham-1-model-nickelate.py
wham-2-plot.py
wham-3-interactions.py
wham-4-flow.py

for the tutorial presented at an internal workshop in 2023, or

emergent-0-drosophila.py
emergent-1-orbitals.py
emergent-2-plot.py
emergent-3-model-details.py
emergent-4-symmetries.py
emergent-5-npatch.py
emergent-6-patchplot.py
emergent-7-tufrg.py
emergent-8-flow.py
emergent-9-nonsu2.py

for the tutorial presented at EMERGENT in Sep, 2023.

The C/C++ interface is documented in a step-by-step fashion in the documentation of the C library or by looking at several of the C/C++ examples. A good starting point is examples/hubbard.c
